article_summaries.title: Loading... Forgetting to Wipe
article_summaries.summary: This Ten Ton Hammer newsletter is mostly about other MMOs, but it reports that Free Realms launched on April 28, 2009 and wiped beta characters, compensating testers with a virtual military hat. It also notes the free-to-play mini-games and that the Free Realms forum opened April 29, and links a Bixies Gone Bad quest guide stating the quest can be done at Brawler level 4.
